name: Map Reveal
description: The geography-discovery look: a hyper-saturated satellite-style relief map of a country or continent seen from above at a slight tilt (ochre deserts, green coasts, hillshaded ridges, glowing rivers, deep-blue ocean) with bold red curved arrows sweeping in, pulsing target rings, glowing highlight zones, pins, dotted routes, numbered markers, stat badges and huge thumbnail-style headlines with heavy black outlines. Slow push-ins and fly-tos between regions, clouds drifting over, a globe spin to the country. For geography, discovery, megaproject and 'insane facts' storytelling.
fonts: Impact, "Arial Narrow", "Helvetica Neue", Inter, "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif
